IDENT.title: From Automation to Autonomy: A Digital Twin Framework for Transparent Agent and Human Collaboration in Industrial Multi-Agent Systems

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: Agent defined as an entity situated in an environment that senses parameters and makes decisions/actions to achieve goals; adopted from Dorri et al. [8].
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: It is defined as an entity situated in an environment that senses various parameters and, based on these perceptions in conjunction with its goals, makes decisions

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: The environment refers to the context or location in which the agent operates, such as a network or a software platform [8].

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: Within this context, multiagent systems (MAS) offer a promising approach for automating tasks and processes based on autonomous agents

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: Within this setup, two agents automate tasks of the CST plant operation process

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: This AAS instance encapsulates both its static design-time and its dynamic run-time information comprised into AAS submodels.

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: making use of the proposed AAS ontology by Bayha et al. [38], two submodels form the core elements of the DT data model

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: Its goal is to compute an optimized operating schedule, including start/stop times, strategic decisions for power generation or storage

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: does not allow for empirically assessing scalability to larger agent populations

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: both agents are enhanced with a generic agent-proxy module1. This module facilitates the integration of agents with the DT service layer

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: Data is managed using a document-based MongoDB for live data4 as well as TimescaleDB for historical data5.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: DT database persists agent design-time models and run-time execution records (external to agent).
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: a database, which ensures persistent storage of AAS-based agent models and run-time execution records

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: agents can actively request data using an API or automatically receive notifications by subscribing to events such as value updates

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: real-time run-time updates are communicated back to the DT infrastructure

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: the module exposes an REST API, enabling the unified invocation of the agent operation by other MAS entities

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: an agent can autonomously discover and invoke the capabilities of other agents

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: the DT infrastructure acts as an intermediary information system for the collaboration of agents and humans

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_analyzed.evidence_quote: On average, read and write requests to DT service infrastructure take about 40 ms

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.value: Request latency (avg ~40 ms, 10-50 ms, p95 <50 ms)
D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.evidence_quote: the latencies ranged between 10 ms and 50 ms, with the 95th percentile below 50 ms

E_LEARNING__simulation_model_source.evidence_quote: to parameterize a simplified CST plant model

F_DT_COUPLING__dt_present_in_work.evidence_quote: proposes to introduce a DT infrastructure as a service layer for system coordination, supervision, and interaction

F_DT_COUPLING__agent_dt_coupling.evidence_quote: strict separation of components into the MAS and DT layer

F_DT_COUPLING__dt_generation_from_agent_.evidence_quote: Agents register themselves in the DT infrastructure during initial deployment or re-deployment, so that the current AAS instance of the agent is created

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: Tests are then conducted in a 30 h test period in the CST plant heat generation process

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: in which there was no agent-centric service layer based on a DT and the agent behavior was largely opaque

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: capability of the solution to seamlessly add or remove agents from the MAS

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: the current evaluation involves a minimal multi-agent configuration with two agents

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: The case study is conducted in the context of a semi-autonomous CST plant

H_STANDARDS__standards_referenced.evidence_quote: the AAS of the Reference Architecture Model Industry 4.0 (RAMI 4.0) is being used

H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.value: AAS capability ontology by Bayha et al.; NGSI-LD
H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.evidence_quote: making use of the proposed AAS ontology by Bayha et al. [38]

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: guaranteeing technical interoperability between both standards

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: Explicit modeling of capabilities within the AAS supports automated discovery of suitable agents to handle certain tasks

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Uses DT to represent software agents themselves (AAS per agent) with central broker, human supervision HMIs and alerting; no part agents, no negotiation or plan generation.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: the use of DTs to represent and provide access not only to physical resources but to agents in the MAS itself

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Claims shared virtual representation of software agents is required for transparency.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: a shared virtual representation of software agents is required in addition to the virtual representation of physical assets

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: new agents can easily register on the system so that other agents and human operators can find the agents
